heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 87–456, title III, § 303(c), May 24, 1962, 76 Stat. 78

notes.text: Section, act Aug. 27, 1949, ch. 517, § 1, 63 Stat, 666, provided for free importation of articles for members of armed forces of foreign countries.
Effective Date of RepealFor effective date of repeal, see section 501(a) of Pub. L. 87–456.
